title: Bank of England Bank Rate announcement and February 2027 Monetary Policy Report (12:00 London / 07:00 ET) — the forecast round uk-cpi-2027-01-20 feeds, and the only one it feeds
source: EST: bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy/upcoming-mpc-dates, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the page is titled 'Monetary Policy Committee dates for 2026 and 2027' and lists, under the heading '2027 provisional dates', 'Thursday 4 February — February MPC Summary and minutes and February Monetary Policy Report'. The BoE's own word is PROVISIONAL, so the estimate label is exact here and is not merely the taxonomy artifact the sibling ONS entries carry: the publisher itself has not fixed the date. Also filed estimate on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for the Bank of England. Proposed by the never-assessed initial research of uk-cpi-2027-01-20, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-cpi-2027-01-20 LANE, 2026-09-09. Why it earns a slot: it is the venue that gives this calendar's January UK CPI print whatever consequence it has. Exactly ONE CPI print falls between the 2026-12-17 announcement (boe-decision-2026-12-17) and this one — the 2027-01-20 release of December 2026 data — and this meeting carries a full Monetary Policy Report forecast round, so the print is a forecast-conditioning input with fifteen days to be absorbed rather than a voting-morning datum. That is the exact inverse of the December configuration the uk-cpi-2026-12-16 lane established, where the print publishes 07:00 on the morning the meeting ends. MEETING-END DATE IS AN INFERENCE, NOT A PUBLICATION: the BoE announces one day after the meeting ends (July 2026 minutes, quoted in docs/research/events/uk-cpi-2026-12-16.md: 'meeting ending on 16 September will be published on 17 September 2026'), so a 4 February announcement implies a meeting ending 3 February. Tiered MEDIUM to match boe-decision-2026-12-17 and the other BoE entries on this calendar. symbols: [], no UK listing and no rates- or sterling-keyed house playbook; the nearest measured transmission channel this repo has is the gilt-to-Treasury pipe in uk-autumn-budget-2026-10-28, which opens only on the worst ~1% of gilt days. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
